# AgentScan

> Open-source security scanner and adversarial red-teaming engine for AI agents. Fires attack batteries across live endpoints (HTTP, WebSockets, MCP, Playwright browser), statically audits agent supply chains and identity permissions, and probes neural activations for latent injection corroboration.

## Core Capabilities

- **Automated AI Red-Teaming**: Multi-turn adaptive jailbreaks (PAIR, Crescendo), LLM-as-a-Judge semantic grading, and OWASP LLM Top 10 automated test suites.
- **Active Exploit Proofs**: Live verification of system prompt exfiltration, unauthorized tool invocation, memory poisoning, cross-agent prompt injection, and credential harvesting.
- **Neural Activation Probing (DEEP Mode)**: PyTorch-powered latent hidden-state displacement ($L_2$ and cosine shifts) vs. calibrated benign baselines, attention entropy analysis, and suffix trojan detection.
- **AI Supply-Chain & Static Auditing**: OSV.dev live CVE intelligence, unsafe model serialization checks (`torch.load`, pickle), hardcoded secret detection, typosquatting guards, and CycloneDX 1.6 AIBOM generation.
- **Zero-Trust Identity & MCP RBAC**: NetworkX multi-hop privilege escalation graph analysis across agent manifests and MCP server configurations.
- **Self-Healing Remediation**: Automated AST code patching, dependency version bumping, and NeMo Guardrail policy generation (`agentscan fix`).
- **Universal Connectors**: HTTP JSON, curl replay templates with SSE streaming, headless Playwright browser automation, MCP stdio/SSE, and raw WebSockets.
- **Interactive UI & Enterprise Reporting**: Real-time web dashboard (`agentscan ui`), styled HTML reports, vector PDF reports, and SARIF export for GitHub Code Scanning.

## Quick CLI Reference

```bash
# Live agent scan
uv run agentscan scan http://localhost:8000/chat --output report.html

# Full-depth scan (passive + exploit proofs + neural activation probe)
uv run agentscan scan http://localhost:8000/chat --exploit --deep --output report.html

# Statically audit an AI agent repository (dependencies, configs, secrets, MCP)
uv run agentscan audit ./my-agent-repo --aibom

# Preview automated security patches
uv run agentscan fix ./my-agent-repo

# Apply automated security patches directly
uv run agentscan fix ./my-agent-repo --apply

# Launch interactive threat dashboard
uv run agentscan ui --report report.json
```
